When we first joined this family, my husband had lost his job. At that time, through Gurudev’s guidance and spiritual processes, he received a new job within just one week. For us, this was truly a miraculous experience in our lives.

The Diamond Membership has given me the opportunity to serve, discover my hidden talents, and grow personally. I have offered seva in writing and event activities, which helped me develop greater confidence and a sense of responsibility.

For me, Paramsukh Total Wellness – Scientific Life Counselling, Global Gurukul is a wonderful platform for peace, success, spiritual growth, and self-discovery. Here, I truly feel the presence and blessings of Satguru and Prabhu, guiding our lives in the right direction.

With full faith and gratitude, I give 5 Stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ and wholeheartedly recommend that Diamond Membership is not just a course, but a life-long transformation family. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Pranay Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude for the exceptional occupational therapy sessions you conducted for my nephew, Devansh since 2years. When we began this journey, Devansh was experiencing hyperactivity and delayed speech. However, since attending your sessions, we have observed remarkable improvements in multiple areas of his development.

His speech and comprehension have shown significant progress. He is now able to form sentences, relate words meaningfully, and engage in conversations with confidence. There has also been a noticeable improvement in his social skills. He interacts more comfortably with others and has started enjoying his time at school.

One of the most encouraging developments is his ability to recite rhymes and poems with ease. He performed exceptionally well in his school’s oral examinations, which was a proud moment for all of us.
His behavior has also changed positively, he is no longer prone to anger or stubbornness, and he now listens and responds thoughtfully.

In addition, Devansh’s reading skills have greatly improved. He can now read sentences clearly and with understanding. Academically, he has begun to solve math
problems independently and has even developed an interest in the subject.

Overall, there has been a tremendous transformation in both his academic abilities and behavior, all thanks to your dedicated efforts.
We are truly grateful for the positive impact you have had on Devansh’s  overall development

Thank you once again, Ma’am. 🙏🏻😊
